description: This is a Java enum class defining roles within an interoperation context, specifically for transactions such as payer and payee, with associated transaction behaviors.

classes.name: InteropTransactionRole
classes.description: An enum representing roles in an interoperation transaction, with methods to identify role type and transaction type.

methods.name: isWithdraw
methods.description: Returns true if the role is PAYER, indicating a withdrawal.

methods.name: getTransactionType
methods.description: Returns the corresponding SavingsAccountTransactionType based on the role: WITHDRAWAL for PAYER, DEPOSIT for PAYEE.
